records.name: Dynamite Kick
records.skill_description: A chargeable Strike Super in which the user kicks the opponent; charging increases the number and power of the follow-up hits.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a short-range chargeable kick. The move can reach up to 13 hits and ends with knockback; the canonical source reports substantially greater damage when fully charged. Exact frame data is not encoded.
records.acquisition_notes: Hercule training is the canonical Xenoverse 2 acquisition route. Independent training guides identify Dynamite Kick as the first Hercule training reward.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Charge time makes the move vulnerable without a setup, while a fully charged version is substantially stronger. Exact matchup/frame claims remain version-sensitive.
